summary: BRBI BR Partners S.A. filed a Form 6-K with a notice to shareholders regarding the payment of interim dividends for Q1 2026. The board approved a total dividend of R$18,899,226.72, or R$0.06 per share (R$0.18 per UNIT). The record date is May 18, 2026, with ex-dividend trading starting May 19, 2026, and payment on May 29, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration with no special-situation components such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or strategic review. The filing represents a standard capital return to shareholders in the ordinary course of business.
